name: Trampling Livestock AP
description: Several ghostly mammoths arise from the floorboards, pawing at the ground in terror before stampeding toward the door.
disable: DC 28 Religion to exorcise the animals' spirits, or DC 26 Nature or Stabling Lore|dc:24 to soothe them

generalAbilities.name: Sudden Stampede
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger The door to the stable opens

Effect The mammoth spirits activate in panic, materializing into physical forms as they stampede toward the door to escape. All creatures standing within 20 feet of the door take (4d10+26) Force Damage damage (Basic DC 28 Reflex Saving Throw save).
